title: 17087 - 17087/P0703/001795
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Brake Switch (F) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Brake Switch (F)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Vehicles with Drive-by-Cable (DBC) the Brake Switch (F) is connected to the Transmission Control Module. On older Models this Code is stored automatically after Terminal 15/Ignition is switched ON. If the Brake Switch (F) sağlam olmalıdır you can avoid this Fault Code by pressing the Brake Pedal after switching on the Ignition and prior to checking Fault Codes. The Code should automatically be cleared then.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Vehicles with Drive-by-Wire (DBW) the Brake Switch (F) is connected to the Engine Control Module In this case you should Kontrol edin: the Engine Control Module for Fault Codes as well and the Data Bus Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Engine and Transmission Control Module.
